name: codex-discord-channel
description: Claude-style Discord channel ownership for Codex sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Bind a Discord bot instance to the active Codex session.
interface.longDescription: A session-local Discord channel plugin for Codex. It keeps one active owner per bot instance and persistently queues accepted inbound messages until delivery can be verified without unsafe terminal keystrokes.
defaultPrompt: Use $codex-discord-channel to check Discord channel status.
Claim this Codex session as the Discord bot owner.
Send a Discord reply from this Codex session.
